summary: This directory manages the core business logic and domain model entities. It defines the state, rules, and fundamental operations that govern the application's domain, ensuring consistency across all functional modules.
responsibilities: Defining core domain models and data structures
Encapsulating business rules and validation logic
Managing state transitions and domain behavior
relationships: Domain entities enforce business rules to maintain data integrity.
Validation logic ensures that state transitions adhere to defined business constraints.
designDecisions: Domain-driven design to isolate business logic from infrastructure concerns
Immutability for state objects to ensure predictability
Encapsulation of logic within entities to prevent leakage
